Morgan Hale

Morgan

Best,
Morgan Hale
Halcyon Threshold

Halcyon Threshold

Working toward the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.

Mission. Halcyon Threshold is an independent effort to contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI. We believe this is the most important technology of our lifetime, and that more independent voices — outside the frontier labs — should be working on how it goes well.

Why this matters

Superintelligent AI could be the best thing that ever happened to the world — or it could go badly. The difference depends on choices made now: how models are evaluated, how safety research is replicated independently, how governance keeps pace with capability, and whether people outside the labs have the resources to contribute.

Most AI safety work happens inside the labs building the systems. We think there's a neglected role for independent evaluation, replication, and field-building.

What we're doing

  • Independent evaluation. Reproducing key safety results from frontier labs and publishing independent assessments — starting with evaluations of agent autonomy.
  • Field-building. Connecting independent researchers with compute, funding, and collaborators.
  • Grants. Making small, fast grants to neglected AI safety projects.

Get in touch

Email: morgan@halcyonthreshold.org

Halcyon Threshold · morgan@halcyonthreshold.org

# Emberfall Fund Rapid Grant Proposal

**Applicant:** Morgan Hale (Halcyon Threshold)
**Round:** November 2026 (closes Nov 30)
**Amount requested:** $15,000
**Project duration:** 3 months (December 2026 – February 2027)

---

## 1. What we'll do

**Project:** Independent replication of frontier AI safety evaluations, with a focus on agent autonomy.

Frontier labs publish safety evaluation results for their models, but these results are produced by the labs themselves — the same organizations building the systems. There is no independent check. This project will:

1. Select 3–5 recently published safety evaluations from frontier labs (focused on agent autonomy and dangerous capability thresholds).
2. Reproduce the evaluations on the same or comparable models using open scaffolding where available.
3. Publish an independent assessment: do the results replicate? Where do they diverge? What are the limitations?
4. Release the replication code and methodology so others can extend it.

**Outputs:**
- 3–5 independent replication reports
- Open-source replication code (Python, published under a permissive license)
- A short methodology guide for independent safety eval replication

---

## 2. Why me / why Halcyon Threshold

- I've been following AI safety for several years and recently organized a local meetup on superintelligence risk.
- I have working Python skills and can run evals, analyze results, and write clearly.
- Halcyon Threshold is set up as an independent vehicle for this work (domain, website, bank account separate from my employer).
- I can commit evenings and weekends (~10–15 hours/week) for the duration of the project.

**Constraint:** I am employed at Dorrance Logistics. My contract requires disclosure of outside activities. I am filing the disclosure (due Nov 30) and will not use Dorrance resources or time for this project. All work will be done independently, on my own equipment and time.

---

## 3. What it costs

| Item | Amount |
|------|--------|
| Cloud compute (model API calls, eval runs) | $6,000 |
| Supplemental compute (Compute Commons credits applied for) | $3,000 (in-kind) |
| Domain, hosting, incidental software | $500 |
| Contractor support (data analysis, ~40 hrs at $40/hr) | $1,600 |
| My time (stipend, evenings/weekends) | $6,900 |
| **Total requested** | **$15,000** |

The Cloud compute line covers API access to frontier models for running evaluations. If Compute Commons credits are approved, that portion would shift to credits rather than cash.

---

## 4. Timeline

- **December 2026:** Select evaluations, secure model access, write replication harness
- **January 2027:** Run replications, analyze results, draft reports
- **February 2027:** Publish reports and code, methodology guide, share with Alignment Commons

---

**Contact:** morgan@halcyonthreshold.org
